Class ResearchService

java.lang.Object
project.services.ResearchService
public class ResearchService extends Object
Orchestrates all research-related operations: papers, citations, supervisors, and rankings.

    • setSupervisor

      public void setSupervisor(GraduateStudent grad, ResearcherDecorator supervisor)
      Assigns a research supervisor to a graduate student. Prints an error message if the supervisor doesn't meet the h-index requirement.
      Parameters:
      grad - the graduate student needing supervision
      supervisor - the proposed supervisor

    • addDiplomaProject

      public void addDiplomaProject(GraduateStudent grad, ResearchPaper paper)
      Attaches a diploma/thesis paper to a graduate student's profile and saves to disk.
      Parameters:
      grad - the graduate student
      paper - the paper to attach

    • addResearcherPaper

      public void addResearcherPaper(User user, ResearchPaper paper, String projectId, String journalName)
      Publishes a paper for a researcher. Optionally links it to a project and/or a journal. Journal publication triggers notifications to all journal subscribers.
      Parameters:
      user - the researcher publishing the paper
      paper - the paper to publish
      projectId - the project to link to, or null/blank to skip
      journalName - the journal to publish in, or null/blank to skip

    • recordCitation

      public void recordCitation(ResearcherDecorator researcher, String doi)
      Increments the citation count of the paper with the given DOI (owned by the researcher).
      Parameters:
      researcher - the researcher who owns the paper
      doi - the DOI of the paper to cite

    • announceTopCitedResearcher

      public void announceTopCitedResearcher()
      Finds the most-cited researcher in the system and posts a news item announcing them.

      public void printTopPapersByCitations()

      public void printPapersByDate()
      Prints all research papers across the system sorted by publish date (newest first).

    • addPaper

      public void addPaper(Teacher teacher, ResearchPaper paper)
      Adds a paper directly for a teacher who already has researcher status in the database. Prints an error if the teacher is not a researcher.
      Parameters:
      teacher - the teacher (must be wrapped in a ResearcherDecorator in the DB)
      paper - the paper to add
